name: ebay-seller-mcp
description: eBay seller MCP server: Terapeak product research (sold prices, sell-through, trends, categories, active competition) and eBay search results as buyers see them — read through the seller's own logged-in Ziniao (紫鸟) store browser — plus listing creation and management (revise, price/stock, end, relist — preview, then apply after confirmation) through the eBay API.
